w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Saiful just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Buffering. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Agnese walks you through Ad Break. (Monster codex: observed.)

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Search locket. The last photo, the one where they're laughing at something off-camera. You'll ask the System what it wants, later. First: them. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Quinn freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Quinn: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: "The future is a rerun. You've just seen the episode."
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "◈ The Records: You won The Box under the cameras. The village's glory, public and loud."
✨ Ability gained: Foresight (L1). Reveal every monster’s intended move for three rounds. Uses no combat action; once per fight.
"The future is a rerun. You've just seen the episode."
"The REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"
Nothing edible. (Hushpuppy (carcass), White Oak Acorns (in shell) — not food yet: A carcass. Clean it with a knife — quickly. Spoils fast..)

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 32 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "The System was going to take Saiful. Saiful is away from Haven. The show must go on — it takes Nora instead."
📺 SYSTEM: "It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/13/8), with 7 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 19 · Craft 9 · Talk 16 · Explore 46 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Meera Reddy ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
